name: cfpb-bank-account-monetary-relief
description: Will a consumer complaint about a checking or savings account be closed with monetary relief by the company?
split_description: Fixed chronological boundaries: train 2019-01-01 through 2021-12-31; eval 2022-01-01 through 2022-12-31; holdout 2023-01-01 through 2023-12-31. No random shuffling and no row crosses a boundary. No embargo is needed because each row is an independent one-shot complaint, no lag or rolling-history features are used, and the 2026-11-08 snapshot gives every cohort years of label maturity.
